title: Bogor, West Java — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Bogor, West Java: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Bogor is a city in West Java with a population of 1,043,000. The Rain City of Indonesia, a lush hill city south of Jakarta known for its botanical gardens, presidential palace, and cool mountain air. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
